note: Synthetic demo records written for this project. Used only when the internet is unavailable. IPs are from documentation ranges (RFC 5737) and are not real hosts.

reports.title: Ransomware gang encrypts servers at regional hospital network, demands payment
reports.summary: A ransomware group using double extortion encrypted file servers at a regional hospital network and threatened to publish stolen patient records on its leak site. Initial access came through an unpatched VPN appliance.

reports.title: Critical VPN flaw CVE-2026-10001 exploited in the wild before patch
reports.summary: Attackers are actively exploiting a critical remote code execution vulnerability in a popular VPN gateway. The zero-day allows unauthenticated attackers to run commands; administrators should patch now. Scanning traffic came from 203.0.113.45 and 198.51.100.23.

reports.title: State-sponsored APT group targets telecom providers with custom backdoor
reports.summary: A nation-state espionage group deployed a new backdoor on routers of telecom providers in Asia. The malware used 192.0.2.77 for command-and-control traffic and hid inside legitimate firmware update processes.

reports.title: Phishing campaign abuses fake Microsoft 365 login pages to steal credentials
reports.summary: A large phishing campaign sends invoice lures that lead to spoofed Microsoft 365 login pages. The adversary-in-the-middle kit captures session cookies and bypasses MFA. Landing domains included login-verify[.]example.

reports.title: Malicious npm packages steal developer tokens in supply chain attack
reports.summary: Researchers found malicious packages on npm that typosquat popular libraries. Once installed, the packages exfiltrate environment variables, cloud access keys and GitHub tokens to an attacker server.

reports.title: Botnet launches 3.1 Tbps DDoS attack against gaming platform
reports.summary: A Mirai-based botnet of compromised IoT devices launched a 3.1 Tbps distributed denial-of-service attack. The amplification traffic peaked for 90 seconds before mitigation.

reports.title: Data breach exposes 4 million customer records at online retailer
reports.summary: An online retailer disclosed a data breach after an exposed database leaked names, addresses and order history of 4 million customers. Stolen data was offered for sale on a criminal forum.

reports.title: Infostealer malware spreads through cracked software downloads
reports.summary: A new infostealer distributed through cracked software sites steals browser passwords, crypto wallets and session tokens. Stolen logs are sold in bulk to initial access brokers.

reports.title: Android banking trojan found in Google Play utility apps
reports.summary: Several utility apps on Google Play carried a banking trojan that abuses accessibility services to steal one-time passwords from mobile banking apps.

reports.title: CISA adds three actively exploited flaws to KEV catalog
reports.summary: CISA added three vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, including an authentication bypass in a file-transfer product. Federal agencies must patch within three weeks.

reports.title: Europol-led operation takes down ransomware infrastructure, two arrested
reports.summary: Law enforcement agencies seized servers and dismantled infrastructure used by a ransomware affiliate program. Two suspects were arrested and decryption keys were recovered for victims.

reports.title: Deepfake voice scam tricks finance employee into wire transfer
reports.summary: Criminals used an AI-generated deepfake voice of a company executive to convince a finance employee to approve an urgent wire transfer. The social engineering attack combined a spoofed email with a phone call.

reports.title: Cloud misconfiguration leaves S3 buckets with backups publicly readable
reports.summary: A misconfigured cloud storage policy left database backups in S3 buckets readable by anyone. The files contained API keys and internal credentials that could enable further compromise.

reports.title: Researchers publish proof-of-concept for web server privilege escalation bug
reports.summary: A proof-of-concept exploit for a privilege escalation bug in a widely used web server was published. No exploitation in the wild has been seen yet, but a patch is available.

reports.title: SSH brute-force wave from compromised hosts hits Linux servers
reports.summary: Honeypots recorded a surge in SSH brute-force attempts from compromised hosts, with 198.51.100.200 among the most active sources. Successful logins dropped a cryptominer.

reports.title: Prompt injection flaw lets attackers hijack AI assistant integrations
reports.summary: A prompt injection vulnerability in an AI assistant plugin let attackers exfiltrate data by planting instructions in shared documents. The vendor released a fix after disclosure.

reports.title: New guidance on securing remote access published by national cyber agency
reports.summary: A national cyber security agency published guidance and best practices for securing remote access, including MFA, patching and network segmentation.

reports.title: Wiper malware disguised as ransomware hits energy sector firms
reports.summary: Destructive wiper malware posing as ransomware destroyed data at energy companies. Analysts attribute the sabotage to a state-backed threat actor.

reports.title: Business email compromise ring steals millions from suppliers
reports.summary: A BEC ring impersonated suppliers through lookalike domains and redirected invoice payments, stealing more than 12 million dollars from victims.

reports.title: Loader malware delivered through malicious search ads
reports.summary: Malicious search ads for popular software lead to fake download sites that install a loader, which then drops remote access trojans and infostealers.
